_comment: Grass/water blob-autotile set, generated via the terrain tileset prompt (ChatGPT). Row-major: 0=grass(pure) 1=grass_water_n 2=grass_water_s 3=grass_water_e 4=grass_water_w 5=grass_water_nw 6=grass_water_ne 7=grass_water_sw 8=grass_water_se 9=water(pure). Use the *_n/s/e/w tiles where grass borders water on exactly one side, the corner tiles where it borders on two adjacent sides, and plain grass/water elsewhere.
